# B"H — 00 — Current Breakage (2026-09-28-1725)

Mission continuation of `geelooy/.ai-thoughts/2026-09-28-1954-heichelos-social-total/`.
Plan only. FILE OWNERSHIP: this directory and nothing else.

## Phase 0 — the boot failure (gating, nothing else matters until fixed)

- `bootIkarFirst is not a function` thrown through the chain
  `critical-boot.js` → `ikar-stable.js` → `ikar-first.js`.
- `/heichelos/ikar` renders EMPTY: `#heichel-boot-title` empty, discovery list empty.
- Document title already says "The Entire Torah" while the body paints nothing.
- Previous continuation's root-cause note: `semantic` was not in the document at
  first-light; boot order/contract mismatch across the three files.
- Public browse of `/heichelos/ikar` showed only "TORAH · LIVING LIBRARY" and "Explore".

## Listing layer — beyond the empty root

- Nested series/post listing redesign was explicitly NOT done (carried in prior
  REMAINING_WORK: "Full Heichel nested series/post listing redesign beyond
  empty-root hydration"). The listing + navigation layer is now a FIRST-CLASS
  track with an "AMAZING, not basic" bar (see 02).

## Reader

- Auto-scroll session already implements Start=river, Stop=still, countdown 0.
- Still missing: interval measurement in a REAL post vessel; regression tests
  (no auto-scroll test script exists — new files required); Scribe's Lens default
  hierarchy browser proof at 390 and 430.

## Social

- Tokens exist (midnight/cyan/violet/gold under `.awtsmoos-social-root`).
- Still missing: community composer de-duplication proof; hub route-by-route
  implementation (profiles, search, notifications).

## Process / environment hazards

- Server is the repo's own `node index` on port 8080 (PID 3818 at last check).
  NO watcher → every code change requires a manual restart or you verify stale code.
- No build script in package.json; package name `awtsfaria`.
- Worktree is DIRTY (dd77276a2) with unrelated tunnel/oauth work plus in-progress
  reader auto-scroll and social CSS. NEVER deploy from this shared tree.
- Tunnel control plane is flaky (observed HTTP 409 tunnel_not_alive AND HTTP 502
  on the route-refresh endpoint). 409s are transient: wait 15s, refresh route,
  retry up to 4x. BLOCKED only if down > 5 min.
- Previous continuation's NEXT_ACTION.md was EMPTY — this plan fills that vacuum.

## Known-good ground (do not re-verify, build on it)

- DB identity LIVE verified: GET /api/social/heichelos/ikar →
  `{"id":"ikar","name":"The Entire Torah","title":"The Entire Torah",
  "author":"awtsmoos","createdAt":1782070065512}`. NO description field exists.
- GET /api/social/heichelos/ikar/series → The Written Torah, The Oral Torah.
- Architecture law: DB → API → semantic model → renderer → UI. Never hard-code
  the Heichel name in presentation; always render from the API payload.
